players.product: AI cluster design/integration & managed services (plus Smart Modular memory)

quarterly_data.signal: Penguin Solutions' fiscal 2026 10-K (year ended August 28, 2026): sales to its ten largest customers were 56% of total net sales (66% in 2025, 58% in 2024). In 2026 net sales to an Integrated Memory customer (not named) were approximately $346.1 million or 20.0% of total net sales; the Advanced Computing customer at 18.2% and 18.4% of net sales in 2025 and 2024 and a different Integrated Memory customer at 14.1% in 2025 were each below 10% in 2026. Advanced Computing net sales decreased in 2026 in part because large hyperscale hardware sales to a significant customer in 2025 did not reoccur; the filing says its AI infrastructure business has been transitioning from a hyperscaler concentration toward a more diversified non-hyperscaler customer base across neocloud, enterprise and sovereign AI. One Integrated Memory customer accounted for more than 10% of accounts receivable at August 28, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Integrated Memory customer $346.1 million or 20.0% of FY2026 net sales; ten largest customers 56%

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K contract balances: deferred revenue was $157.2 million at August 28, 2026 (versus $89,943 thousand a year earlier), of which Penguin expects to recognize $123.3 million in the next 12 months; in 2026 it recognized $73.9 million of revenue from the deferred revenue balance held at August 29, 2025. Advanced Computing managed services engagements typically span three to five years.
quarterly_data.figure: deferred revenue $157.2 million; $123.3 million expected within 12 months
